name: Google reviews
short: Every finished job asks for a review. Replies take one tap.
long: After each job the customer gets a short text with a link to leave a Google review. Every customer is asked, not only the happy ones, because Google’s rules ban picking. New reviews land here with a reply already written to edit and post.
proves: More reviews, and recent ones, keep you near the top of the map.
features: A review ask after every finished job
The rating and review count, month by month
Suggested replies that use the customer’s name and the job
What the customer receives, shown on their phone
story: The firms at the top of the map are rarely the best; they are the ones who ask. This asks every time.
